intent: To maintain a safe distance and speed when approaching the construction zone and upcoming merge point to minimize risks of collisions.
To create more lateral space and prepare for a safe merge due to the low traffic density, lane narrowing, and construction zone.
To prepare for a safe merge and minimize risks associated with reduced maneuvering space, traffic density, and potential collisions.
Slowing down increases reaction time and provides more opportunities to avoid potential collisions.
Maintaining speed helps to keep a safe distance from other vehicles and avoid obstructing traffic flow further, reducing the likelihood of accidents.
